rules.include: Explicit printmaking process, or the auction house's OBRA GRÁFICA category.
rules.exclude: Books/manuscripts, purely photographic records, generic uses of grabado/estampa, and uneditioned offset outside OBRA GRÁFICA.
rules.digital_definition: Giclée, inkjet, impresión digital or chorro de tinta explicitly stated in the catalogue text.
rules.scope_rule: The three-house master represents offered archives; Spanish Auctionet houses are appended as a sold-results-only price archive and never used as an offered-lot denominator.
